Multifunction steering wheel: - The multifunction steering wheel allows operation of the infotainment system, driving assistants and vehicle functions without removing hands from the wheel.
- It contains touch-sensitive areas and physical buttons depending on the model.
- Haptic feedback may be present to confirm input.
- Controls on the left side typically manage cruise control, speed limiter, and distance settings.
- Controls on the right side manage audio volume, track selection, voice commands and Digital Cockpit views.
- Swipe or press motions may be used depending on the specific control layout.
- Steering wheel adjustments (height and depth) are manual using a lever under the column.
- Ensure the wheel is locked in place after adjustment to maintain safety.
